0.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Congratulations on your purchase of the ※★ workshop, a ★※☆ of the─of the─of the─ “Impeccable quality” is our motto!<hex:021A020103>
0.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Congratulazioni per aver acquistato l’officina ※★, un ★※☆ di─di─di─«qualità impeccabile»: è il nostro motto!<hex:021A020103>

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_Q1_000_000
1.description: What would you like to ask about?

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_110_000
8.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Your new ※★ workshop is equipped with the latest in ★※☆, allowing you to ※☆★※☆ the envy of your friends and neighbors!<hex:021A020103>
8.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>La tua nuova officina ※★ è dotata delle tecnologie più moderne ★※☆, così puoi ※☆★※☆ diventare l’invidia di amici e vicini!<hex:021A020103>

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_110_001
9.description: You may use your workshop's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>fabrication station<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to begin a new project or manage one in progress.
9.translation_description: Puoi usare la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>stazione di fabbricazione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> della tua officina per avviare un nuovo progetto o gestirne uno già in corso.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_110_002
10.description: Projects may require the cooperation of free company members due to the amount of materials required. To facilitate this process, a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>company chest<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is also available.
10.translation_description: La quantità di materiali necessaria può richiedere la collaborazione dei membri della Compagnia Libera. Per agevolare il lavoro, è disponibile anche un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>forziere della Compagnia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_110_003
11.description: Plans for new projects can be drafted with the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>schematic board<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
11.translation_description: Puoi preparare i progetti alla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>lavagna degli schemi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_120_000
12.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Airship components? Aetherial wheel stands? ★※☆※? Whatever your dream, the ※★ workshop can help you make it a reality!<hex:021A020103>
12.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Componenti per aeronave? Supporti per ruote eteree? ★※☆※? Qualunque sia il tuo sogno, l’officina ※★ può aiutarti a realizzarlo!<hex:021A020103>

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_A2_000_001
14.translation_description: Il registro di fabbricazione della Compagnia.

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_A2_000_004
17.description: Advancing to the next production phase.
17.translation_description: Passaggio alla fase di produzione successiva.

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_210_000
19.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Even the best culinarian needs a cookbook, which is why the ※★ workshop comes with a ★※☆※★☆ of projects so ※★☆※ even a child could follow!<hex:021A020103>
19.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Anche al miglior cuoco serve un ricettario: ecco perché l’officina ※★ offre una ★※☆※★☆ di progetti, così ※★☆※ che perfino un bambino potrebbe seguirli!<hex:021A020103>

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_210_001
20.description: To begin a new project, open the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>company crafting log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> via the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>fabrication station<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, then select the item you wish to construct followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Begin<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
20.translation_description: Per avviare un nuovo progetto, apri il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>registro di fabbricazione della Compagnia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dalla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>stazione di fabbricazione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, seleziona l’oggetto da costruire e poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Avvia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

21.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_210_002
21.description: Be advised that many projects are comprised of multiple <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>production phases<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
21.translation_description: Molti progetti si articolano in più <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>fasi di produzione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_210_003
22.description: Each phase will require different materials to complete, which can be reviewed via the company crafting log.
22.translation_description: Per completare ogni fase servono materiali diversi, consultabili nel registro di fabbricazione della Compagnia.

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_210_004
23.description: Full estate exterior projects are especially complex and must be constructed one section at a time. These sections may be comprised of multiple production phases, so take care to confirm the requirements beforehand.
23.translation_description: I progetti per l’allestimento completo degli esterni di una tenuta sono particolarmente complessi e vanno costruiti un settore alla volta. Ogni settore può articolarsi in più fasi di produzione: controlla prima i requisiti.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_220_000
24.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>We here at ※☆★ like to say, “The ★※☆※ that ※★ together ★※☆ together!”<hex:021A020103>

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_220_001
25.description: In order to advance to the next <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>production phase<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, your free company will need to contribute sufficient materials.
25.translation_description: Per passare alla <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>fase di produzione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> successiva, la tua Compagnia Libera deve conferire una quantità sufficiente di materiali.

26.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_220_002
26.description: Materials can be contributed via the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>fabrication station<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
26.translation_description: Puoi conferire i materiali tramite la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>stazione di fabbricazione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_220_003
27.description: Please note that a large quantity of materials, crafted or gathered by a variety of classes, may be required.
27.translation_description: Potrebbero servire molti materiali, fabbricati o raccolti da classi diverse.

28.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_220_004
28.description: If you wish to complete projects quickly, you must enlist the support of as many free company members as possible.
28.translation_description: Se vuoi completare rapidamente i progetti, chiedi aiuto al maggior numero possibile di membri della Compagnia Libera.

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_230_001
30.description: When contributing materials to a project, there is a chance that the construction <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>quality<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase.
30.translation_description: Quando conferisci materiali a un progetto, la sua <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>qualità di costruzione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> potrebbe aumentare.

31.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_230_002
31.description: Construction quality will influence the amount of progress made when advancing to the next production phase or completing a project.
31.translation_description: La qualità di costruzione determina quanti progressi fai quando passi alla fase successiva o completi un progetto.

32.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_240_000
32.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>When it's time to ★※☆, make sure you're prepared! Don't forget your ※★☆※!<hex:021A020103>
32.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Preparati quando sarà il momento di ★※☆! Non dimenticare il tuo ※★☆※!<hex:021A020103>

34.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_240_002
34.description: In order to advance to the next production phase, you must first change classes to a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Disciple of the Hand<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
34.translation_description: Per passare alla fase di produzione successiva, devi prima cambiare classe e diventare un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Discepolo della Mano<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

35.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_250_000
35.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Great project, or greatest project? It all depends on ★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>
35.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Un grande progetto o il migliore di tutti? Dipende da ★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>

36.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_250_001
36.description: Depending on your construction quality, when advancing to the next production phase, there is a chance you will make <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>excellent<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> or <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>outstanding<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> progress.
36.translation_description: In base alla qualità di costruzione, passando alla fase successiva potresti ottenere progressi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>eccellenti<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> o <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>eccezionali<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

37.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_250_002
37.description: There is also a chance that your fabrication <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>conditions<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> may change as well.
37.translation_description: Potrebbero cambiare anche le <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>condizioni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> di fabbricazione.

38.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_250_003
38.description: Improved progress and conditions will result in reduced material requirements for the subsequent production phase, as well as bonuses when contributing to the project.
38.translation_description: Progressi e condizioni migliori riducono i materiali richiesti per la fase successiva e danno bonus quando conferisci materiali al progetto.

39.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_130_000
39.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Not satisfied with your choice of projects? ※★ something new and ※☆★ with the aid of your trusty ★※☆!<hex:021A020103>
39.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Non ti soddisfano i progetti disponibili? ※★ qualcosa di nuovo e ※☆★ con l’aiuto della tua fidata ★※☆!<hex:021A020103>

40.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_130_001
40.description: To draft a new project, access the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>schematic board<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, then select the type of plan you wish to create. Review the requirements for the available plans, then select the one you wish to draft.
40.translation_description: Per preparare un nuovo progetto, apri la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>lavagna degli schemi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e seleziona il tipo di progetto da creare. Consulta i requisiti dei progetti disponibili e poi scegli quello che vuoi preparare.

41.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_130_002
41.description: New plans will be automatically added to the company crafting log and can be used immediately following creation.
41.translation_description: I nuovi progetti vengono aggiunti automaticamente al registro di fabbricazione della Compagnia e possono essere usati subito dopo la creazione.

42.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_140_000
42.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>To slip the surly bonds of ※☆★ and touch the face of ※★. To fly above the clouds! To dive beneath the waves! The dream of man and ★※★ alike...<hex:021A020103>
42.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Liberarsi dai vincoli di ※☆★ e sfiorare il volto di ※★. Volare sopra le nuvole! Tuffarsi sotto le onde! Il sogno dell’uomo e di ※★ allo stesso modo...<hex:021A020103>

43.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_Q3_000_000
43.description: What would you like to ask about?

50.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_310_000
50.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Eager to get started? All you need is ※☆★ and quality ★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>
50.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Non vedi l’ora di cominciare? Ti bastano ※☆★ e ★※☆※ di qualità!<hex:021A020103>

51.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_310_001
51.description: To outfit and register an airship, you must have in your possession the requisite components and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>flight credits<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
51.translation_description: Per allestire e registrare un’aeronave, devi possedere i componenti necessari e i <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>permessi di volo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

52.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_310_002
52.description: Flight credits can be purchased from resident caretakers with company credits, whereas <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>airship components<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be constructed in your company workshop. Please note that hull, rigging, forecastle, and aftcastle components are required to outfit an airship.
52.translation_description: I permessi di volo si acquistano dai custodi residenziali con crediti della Compagnia, mentre i <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>componenti per aeronave<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si possono costruire nell’officina della Compagnia. Per allestire un’aeronave occorrono scafo, sartiame, castello di prua e castello di poppa.

53.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_320_000
53.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Having trouble picking the right ★※☆ for you? Not to worry! ※★☆※ put it best when ※★ said, “★※☆※※☆★.”<hex:021A020103>
53.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Fai fatica a scegliere la ★※☆ giusta per te? Niente paura! ※★☆※ aveva ragione quando ※★ ha detto: «★※☆※※☆★».<hex:021A020103>

54.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_320_001
54.description: Each component will affect your airship's performance in a variety of ways.
54.translation_description: Ogni componente influisce in modo diverso sulle prestazioni dell’aeronave.

55.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_320_002
55.description: You may wish to change components depending on how you intend to deploy your airship.
55.translation_description: Puoi cambiare i componenti in base a come intendi impiegare l’aeronave.

56.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_330_000
56.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Don't forget that there are limits to ※☆★, even if you have all the ★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>
56.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Ricorda che ※☆★ ha un limite, anche se possiedi tutti i ★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>

57.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_330_001
57.description: Airship components are comprised of multiple <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>parts<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. The combined total of all component parts cannot exceed the vessel's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>capacity<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
57.translation_description: I componenti dell’aeronave sono composti da più <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>parti<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. La somma delle parti non può superare la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>capacità<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> del mezzo.

58.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_330_002
58.description: As your airship's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>rank<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> increases, the vessel's capacity will as well.
58.translation_description: Aumentando il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>grado<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dell’aeronave aumenta anche la sua capacità.

59.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_330_003
59.description: Your airship's rank will increase as it gains experience via exploratory voyages.
59.translation_description: Il grado dell’aeronave sale con l’esperienza ottenuta durante i viaggi esplorativi.

60.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_340_000
60.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Your ★※☆※ mammet is the perfect ※☆★, equipped to handle all eventualities─such as ★※☆※, ★※☆, or even something so patently ridiculous and unlikely as ★※☆※※☆★!<hex:021A020103>
60.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Il tuo mammet ★※☆※ è il ※☆★ perfetto, pronto ad affrontare ogni evenienza─come ★※☆※, ★※☆ o perfino qualcosa di palesemente assurdo e improbabile come ★※☆※※☆★!<hex:021A020103>

61.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_340_001
61.description: To chart an exploratory voyage, access the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage control panel<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and select an airship, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Deploy airship on exploratory voyage<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Once you have finalized the details, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Deploy<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and the voyage will commence.
61.translation_description: Per pianificare un viaggio esplorativo, apri il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pannello di controllo dei viaggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e seleziona un’aeronave. Poi scegli <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Invia l’aeronave in un viaggio esplorativo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Una volta definiti i dettagli, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Invia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per dare inizio al viaggio.

62.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_340_002
62.description: Each voyage will require a number of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>ceruleum tanks<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which can be purchased with company credits from the mammet voyager #004A or resident caretakers.
62.translation_description: Ogni viaggio richiede alcuni <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>serbatoi di ceruleo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, acquistabili con crediti della Compagnia dal mammet viaggiatore #004A o dai custodi residenziali.

63.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_340_003
63.description: Once your airship returns, you can review the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and collect any items found during the voyage. These items may prove useful in drafting plans for new projects.
63.translation_description: Al ritorno dell’aeronave, puoi consultare il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>registro di bordo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e raccogliere gli oggetti trovati durante il viaggio. Potrebbero esserti utili per preparare nuovi progetti.

64.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_340_004
64.description: As you continue to conduct exploratory voyages, you will gain access to facilities for registering and housing additional company airships.
64.translation_description: Proseguendo con i viaggi esplorativi, sbloccherai strutture per registrare e alloggiare altre aeronavi della Compagnia.

65.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_350_000
65.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>※☆★ agrees: there's nothing more ★※※★☆※☆ than your mammet's first voyage log!<hex:021A020103>
65.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>※☆★ concorda: non c’è niente di più ★※※★☆※☆ del primo registro di bordo del tuo mammet!<hex:021A020103>

66.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_350_001
66.description: Upon the completion of an exploratory voyage, your mammet will provide a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> detailing the results.
66.translation_description: Al termine di un viaggio esplorativo, il tuo mammet ti fornirà un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>registro di bordo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> con i risultati.

67.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_350_002
67.description: The information contained in this log may prove useful in preparing for your next exploratory voyage.
67.translation_description: Le informazioni contenute nel registro potrebbero esserti utili per preparare il prossimo viaggio esplorativo.

68.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_350_003
68.description: Please note that only the log for the previous voyage will be retained.
68.translation_description: Nota: viene conservato soltanto il registro dell’ultimo viaggio.

69.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_360_000
69.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Though it may seem troublesome at first, we believe you'll find that the care and maintenance of your airship is ※★☆※ as ※★☆※!<hex:021A020103>
69.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Anche se all’inizio prendersi cura dell’aeronave può sembrare una seccatura, vedrai che la manutenzione è ※★☆※ tanto quanto ※★☆※!<hex:021A020103>

70.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_360_001
70.description: The condition of your airship's components will decrease with each exploratory voyage.
70.translation_description: Le condizioni dei componenti dell’aeronave peggiorano a ogni viaggio esplorativo.

71.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_360_002
71.description: Should a component's condition reach 0%, it will suffer <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>catastrophic failure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and you will be unable to deploy your airship.
71.translation_description: Se le condizioni di un componente scendono allo 0%, si verificherà un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>guasto catastrofico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e non potrai più inviare l’aeronave in viaggio.

72.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_360_003
72.description: To repair a component, access the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage control panel<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and select an airship, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Repair airship components<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Please note that you cannot do so without the requisite materials.
72.translation_description: Per riparare un componente, apri il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pannello di controllo dei viaggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e seleziona un’aeronave, poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ripara i componenti dell’aeronave<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Ti serviranno i materiali necessari.

73.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_150_000
73.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Do you crave adventure and excitement? Glory and wealth? Are you prepared to accept ★※☆※※☆★ violent death? Then to you brave souls we say come─the Diadem awaits!<hex:021A020103>
73.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Cerchi avventura ed emozioni? Gloria e ricchezze? Affronteresti anche una morte violenta ★※☆※※☆★? Allora vi diciamo, animi impavidi: venite─la Diadema vi attende!<hex:021A020103>

74.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_150_001
74.description: <hex:021A020203>This new frontier is filled with untold spoils ripe for the taking! With ★※☆※, you can be assured that ★※☆※★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>
74.translation_description: <hex:021A020203>Questa nuova frontiera è ricca di tesori inestimabili tutti da conquistare! Con ★※☆※ hai la certezza che ★※☆※★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>

75.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_Q4_000_000
75.description: What would you like to ask about?

78.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_A4_000_003
78.description: Missions involving two or more parties.
78.translation_description: Missioni che coinvolgono due o più gruppi.

80.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_001
80.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Make sure not to forget your ★※☆※! Our research shows that expeditions with ★※☆※ have a 50% chance of ※☆★ more than 10% of the time!<hex:021A020103>
80.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Non dimenticare il tuo ★※☆※! Le nostre ricerche dimostrano che le spedizioni con ★※☆※ hanno il 50% di possibilità di ※☆★ per più del 10% del tempo!<hex:021A020103>

81.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_002
81.description: In order to embark upon an exploratory mission, you and your party must meet the following requirements:
81.translation_description: Per partecipare a una missione esplorativa, tu e il tuo gruppo dovete soddisfare i seguenti requisiti:

82.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_011
82.description: All party members must have completed the main scenario quest “Heavensward.”
82.translation_description: Tutti i membri del gruppo devono aver completato la missione dello scenario principale «Heavensward».

83.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_012
83.description: All party members must be level 60 Disciples of War or Magic.
83.translation_description: Tutti i membri del gruppo devono essere di livello 60 e appartenere ai Discepoli della Guerra o della Magia.

84.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_003
84.description: Furthermore, all party members must be in possession of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>mission ceruleum<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which may be purchased from resident caretakers or the mammet voyager #004A.
84.translation_description: Inoltre, tutti i membri del gruppo devono possedere <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>ceruleo per missioni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, acquistabile dai custodi residenziali o dal mammet viaggiatore #004A.

85.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_004
85.description: It is possible to participate in missions by forming parties consisting of two or more members.
85.translation_description: Per partecipare alle missioni è possibile formare gruppi di due o più membri.

86.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_005
86.description: If you wish to embark upon a mission with less than eight players, you may do so via the voyage control panel. However, please be advised that you will be unable to add new members during the mission.
86.translation_description: Se vuoi partire per una missione con meno di otto giocatori, puoi farlo tramite il pannello di controllo dei viaggi. Tieni presente, però, che non potrai aggiungere nuovi membri durante la missione.

87.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_013
87.description: Please also be aware that Disciples of War or Magic higher than level 60 will be automatically level synced upon entry.
87.translation_description: Inoltre, i Discepoli della Guerra o della Magia di livello superiore al 60 verranno sincronizzati automaticamente al livello 60 all’ingresso.

88.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_006
88.description: Exploratory missions are subject to a time limit, and you will earn a reward by completing mission objectives within the time given.
88.translation_description: Le missioni esplorative hanno un limite di tempo. Otterrai una ricompensa completando gli obiettivi entro il tempo stabilito.

89.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_510_005
89.description: Successfully completing a mission also earns you the ability to manipulate aetherial gaps, allowing you to pass beyond the Grounding Gale.
89.translation_description: Completare una missione ti permetterà anche di manipolare le fenditure eteriche e attraversare la Raffica Ancorante.

90.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_510_006
90.description: Furthermore, please be advised that you will not be permitted to change to a Disciple of the Land or Hand while on a Trials of the Fury exploratory mission.
90.translation_description: Durante una missione esplorativa delle Prove della Furia, non potrai passare a una classe della Disciplina della Terra o della Mano.

91.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_007
91.description: All items in a player's loot list will automatically be transferred to that player's inventory upon all other party members leaving the area.
91.translation_description: Quando tutti gli altri membri del gruppo avranno lasciato l'area, gli oggetti nell'elenco bottino di ogni giocatore verranno trasferiti automaticamente nel suo inventario.

92.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_008
92.description: Items unable to be obtained will be lost.
92.translation_description: Gli oggetti che non potrai ottenere andranno perduti.

93.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_009
93.description: Please note that once you have participated in an exploratory mission, you may not do so again for 30 minutes (Earth time).
93.translation_description: Dopo aver partecipato a una missione esplorativa, dovrai attendere 30 minuti (tempo terrestre) prima di partecipare di nuovo.

94.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_410_010
94.description: Moreover, the airship which you used to embark upon your mission may not be deployed on missions or voyages for 5 minutes (Earth time).
94.translation_description: Inoltre, l’aeronave usata per partecipare alla missione non potrà essere impiegata in altre missioni o viaggi per 5 minuti (tempo terrestre).

105.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_440_001
105.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>What wonders can be found in the Diadem? How about ★※☆※★☆? Or ※☆★? And yes, even ★※☆※! That's right, brave adventurer! Honest-to-gods ★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>
105.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Quali meraviglie si nascondono nel Diadema? Che ne dici di ★※☆※★☆? O di ※☆★? E anche ★※☆※! Proprio così, coraggioso avventuriero: ★※☆※ autentici, parola di mammet!<hex:021A020103>

106.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_441_001
106.description: Lockboxes obtained during missions can be opened by a picker of locks─a specialist found in Ishgard, the Diadem, or in any residential area.
106.translation_description: I forzieri ottenuti durante le missioni possono essere aperti da uno scassinatore esperto, reperibile a Ishgard, nel Diadema o in qualsiasi quartiere residenziale.

107.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_441_002
107.description: Once opened, you have a chance to receive rewards such as Diadem gear or brass sky pirate spoils.
107.translation_description: Una volta aperti, potrebbero contenere ricompense come l’equipaggiamento del Diadema o cimeli di pirati del cielo in ottone.

108.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_440_003
108.description: The special gear obtained during the course of an exploratory mission can be exchanged for <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>brass sky pirate spoils<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> by speaking with spoils traders in Ishgard, the Diadem, or in any residential district.
108.translation_description: L’equipaggiamento speciale ottenuto durante una missione esplorativa può essere scambiato con <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>cimeli di pirati del cielo in ottone<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> parlando con un mercante di cimeli a Ishgard, nel Diadema o in qualsiasi quartiere residenziale.

109.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_440_103
109.description: Moreover, Disciples of the Land can gather <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>steel sky pirate spoils<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the Diadem after completing a Trials of the Matron mission.
109.translation_description: Dopo aver completato una missione delle Prove della Matrona, i Discepoli della Terra possono raccogliere nel Diadema <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>cimeli di pirati del cielo in acciaio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

110.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_440_004
110.description: These spoils can then be redeemed for a variety of valuable goods by speaking with spoils collectors, who can be found in the company of spoils traders.
110.translation_description: Questi cimeli possono essere scambiati con beni preziosi parlando con i collezionisti di cimeli, che si trovano presso i mercanti.

111.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_Q5_000_000
111.description: What would you like to ask about?

114.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_Q6_000_000
114.description: What would you like to ask about?

115.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_A6_000_001
115.translation_description: Allestimento e registrazione di un sommergibile.

122.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_610_000
122.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Eager to get wet? All you need is ※☆★ and watertight ★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>
122.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Non vedi l’ora di tuffarti? Ti bastano ※☆★ e componenti ★※☆※ a tenuta stagna!<hex:021A020103>

123.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_610_001
123.description: To outfit and register a submersible, you must have in your possession the requisite components and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>dive credits<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
123.translation_description: Per allestire e registrare un sommergibile, devi possedere i componenti necessari e i <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>permessi d’immersione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

124.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_610_002
124.description: Dive credits can be purchased from resident caretakers with company credits, whereas <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>submersible components<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be constructed in your company workshop. Please note that hull, stern, bow, and bridge components are required to outfit a submersible.
124.translation_description: I permessi d’immersione si acquistano dai custodi residenziali con crediti della Compagnia, mentre i <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>componenti per sommergibile<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si costruiscono nell’officina della Compagnia. Per allestirne uno occorrono scafo, poppa, prua e plancia.

125.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_620_000
125.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Having trouble picking the right ★※☆ for you? Not to worry! ※★☆※ put it best when ※★ said, “★※☆※※☆★.”<hex:021A020103>
125.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Fai fatica a scegliere la ★※☆ giusta per te? Niente paura! ※★☆※ aveva ragione quando ※★ ha detto: «★※☆※※☆★».<hex:021A020103>

126.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_620_001
126.description: Each component will affect your submersible's performance in a variety of ways.
126.translation_description: Ogni componente influisce in modo diverso sulle prestazioni del sommergibile.

127.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_620_002
127.description: You may wish to change components depending on how you intend to deploy your submersible.
127.translation_description: Puoi cambiare i componenti in base a come intendi impiegare il sommergibile.

128.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_630_000
128.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Don't forget that there are limits to ※☆★, even if you have all the ★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>
128.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Ricorda che ※☆★ ha un limite, anche se possiedi tutti i ★※☆※!<hex:021A020103>

129.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_630_001
129.description: Submersible components are comprised of multiple <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>parts<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. The combined total of all component parts cannot exceed the vessel's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>capacity<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
129.translation_description: I componenti del sommergibile sono composti da più <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>parti<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. La somma delle parti non può superare la <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>capacità<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> del mezzo.

130.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_630_002
130.description: As your submersible's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>rank<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> increases, the vessel's capacity will as well.
130.translation_description: Aumentando il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>grado<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> del sommergibile aumenta anche la sua capacità.

131.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_630_003
131.description: Your submersible's rank will increase as it gains experience via subaquatic voyages.
131.translation_description: Il grado del sommergibile sale con l’esperienza ottenuta durante i viaggi subacquei.

132.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_640_000
132.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Your ★※☆※ mammet is the perfect ※☆★, equipped to handle all eventualities─such as ★※☆※, ★※☆, or even something so patently ridiculous and unlikely as ★※☆※※☆★!<hex:021A020103>
132.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Il tuo mammet ★※☆※ è il ※☆★ perfetto, pronto ad affrontare ogni evenienza─come ★※☆※, ★※☆ o perfino qualcosa di palesemente assurdo e improbabile come ★※☆※※☆★!<hex:021A020103>

133.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_640_001
133.description: To chart a subaquatic voyage, access the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage control panel<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and select a submersible, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Deploy submersible on subaquatic voyage<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Once you have finalized the details, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Deploy<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and the voyage will commence.
133.translation_description: Per pianificare un viaggio subacqueo, apri il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pannello di controllo dei viaggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e seleziona un sommergibile. Poi scegli <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Invia il sommergibile per un viaggio subacqueo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Una volta definiti i dettagli, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Invia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per dare inizio al viaggio.

134.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_640_002
134.description: Each voyage will require a number of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>ceruleum tanks<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which can be purchased with company credits from the mammet voyager #004A or resident caretakers.
134.translation_description: Ogni viaggio richiede alcuni <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>serbatoi di ceruleo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, acquistabili con crediti della Compagnia dal mammet viaggiatore #004A o dai custodi residenziali.

135.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_640_003
135.description: Once your submersible returns, you can review the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and collect any items found during the voyage. These items may prove useful in drafting plans for new projects.
135.translation_description: Al ritorno del sommergibile, puoi consultare il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>registro di bordo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e raccogliere gli oggetti trovati durante il viaggio. Potrebbero esserti utili per preparare nuovi progetti.

136.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_640_004
136.description: As you continue to conduct subaquatic voyages, you will gain access to facilities for registering and housing additional company submersibles.
136.translation_description: Proseguendo con i viaggi subacquei, sbloccherai strutture per registrare e alloggiare altri sommergibili della Compagnia.

137.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_650_000
137.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>※☆★ agrees: there's nothing more ★※※★☆※☆ than your mammet's first voyage log!<hex:021A020103>
137.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>※☆★ concorda: non c’è niente di più ★※※★☆※☆ del primo registro di bordo del tuo mammet!<hex:021A020103>

138.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_650_001
138.description: Upon the completion of a subaquatic voyage, your mammet will provide a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> detailing the results.
138.translation_description: Al termine di un viaggio subacqueo, il tuo mammet ti fornirà un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>registro di bordo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> con i risultati.

139.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_650_002
139.description: The information contained in this log may prove useful in preparing for your next voyage.
139.translation_description: Le informazioni contenute nel registro potrebbero esserti utili per preparare il prossimo viaggio.

140.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_650_003
140.description: Please note that only the log for the previous voyage will be retained.
140.translation_description: Nota: viene conservato soltanto il registro dell’ultimo viaggio.

141.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_MAMMET00263_660_000
141.description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Though it may seem irksome at first, we believe you'll find that the care and maintenance of your submersible is ※★☆※ as ※★☆※!<hex:021A020103>
141.translation_description: BZZZT...★※☆<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Anche se all’inizio prendersi cura del sommergibile può sembrare una seccatura, vedrai che la manutenzione è ※★☆※ tanto quanto ※★☆※!<hex:021A020103>

142.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_660_001
142.description: The condition of your submersible's components will decrease with each subaquatic voyage.
142.translation_description: Le condizioni dei componenti del sommergibile peggiorano a ogni viaggio subacqueo.

143.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_660_002
143.description: Should a component's condition reach 0%, it will suffer <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>catastrophic failure<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and you will be unable to deploy your submersible.
143.translation_description: Se le condizioni di un componente scendono allo 0%, si verificherà un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>guasto catastrofico<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e non potrai più inviare il sommergibile in viaggio.

144.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWORKSHOPGUIDE_00263_SYSTEM_660_003
144.description: To repair a component, access the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage control panel<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and select a submersible, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Repair submersible components<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Please note that you cannot do so without the requisite materials.
144.translation_description: Per riparare un componente, apri il <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pannello di controllo dei viaggi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> e seleziona un sommergibile, poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ripara i componenti del sommergibile<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Ti serviranno i materiali necessari.
